title: jdx/aube
claim: aube — a Rust Node.js package manager by the maintainer of mise: auto-installs when you run a script, reads existing pnpm/npm/yarn/bun lockfiles in place, and jails lifecycle scripts — the strictest security defaults of any Node PM.
why_good: A Rust Node.js package manager from mise's maintainer — auto-installs on run, with strong pedigree in the dev-tools space.
value: Package managers monetize indirectly (enterprise, registry, support); the wedge is speed + zero-config DX.
risk: npm/pnpm/Bun own this; even great tooling struggles to become a business without a registry/cloud play.

zh.claim: aube —— mise 维护者写的 Rust Node.js 包管理器:运行脚本时自动安装,读取扩展配置。
zh.why_good: 来自 mise 维护者的 Rust Node.js 包管理器——运行即自动安装,在开发工具圈有很强血统。
zh.value: 包管理器靠间接变现(企业、注册表、支持);切口是速度 + 零配置体验。
zh.risk: npm/pnpm/Bun 占据这块;再好的工具没有注册表/云打法也难成生意。
